metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust Cargo project at [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml), with the five CLI commands, entity codecs, evaluators, and diagnostic output. Usage and JSON extensions are documented in the [README](/workspace/output/README.md).

The release build and six automated tests pass. Additional constructed fixtures exercised all 87 catalog shapes, evaluator families, malformed-input checks, and byte-stable second round trips.

**The full lossless requirement remains unverified:** no real-world CAD files were available for testing, and parameter-section comment text is discarded. Some Type 402 form data is preserved through a documented JSON extension because the supplied canonical schema cannot represent all of its fields.

    def test_zero_count_hollerith_is_rejected_after_defaulted_string_control(
        submission_command: Sequence[str], tmp_path: Path

            "1.0E-6",
            "1000.0",
            hollerith("John"),
            hollerith("Org"),
            "11",
            "0",
            "",
            "",

        valid = _parse_raw_document(
            submission_command,
            tmp_path,
            make_empty_iges(build_global_payload(fields)),
            name="hollerith-default-control",

        global_section = valid["global"]
